Grilled Ham and Swiss Sandwich
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




2 Slices White Bread
3 Pieces Thin Sliced Ham
2 Slices Swiss Cheese
2 pats of butter

Preparation

1 Melt butter in skillet. 2 Stack sandwich like so: bread, ham, ham, ham, swiss, bread. 3 Place sandwich in skillet, let brown.  Adjust heat as needed. 4 Remove the sandwich briefly from the skillet, add the other piece of butter and let it melt. 5 Flip sandwich over and brown. Cook until cheese is melted. 6 Eat hot.

About


Simple, elegant, and will most likely kill you eventually from all the butter, but it's important; butter rocks.
